name: Barbell Step-Up
steps: Face a stable box with the bar across your upper back and place one whole foot on top.
Push through the raised foot and extend the hip and knee to stand on the box.
Step down with the trailing foot first and lower under control.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your elevated heel planted flat and avoid springing upward off your back toes.
Track your working knee in line with your toes without letting it cave inward.
